decisions.reason: Although a hardware product is costlier to carry and by 2022 it should be judged against clearer aspirations, it remains close to the core portfolio in a growing firm and industry, so we would keep it unless performance is clearly disappointing.
This module fits the firm's digitalization and traceability path, leverages existing systems, and is relatively inexpensive to maintain, so behavioral-theory logic favors retention.

The app is somewhat more peripheral and its standalone results may fall short of aspirations after several years, but it still supports the installed base and service offering enough to justify keeping it for now.
Inline code verification is tightly aligned with customers' compliance and end-to-end traceability needs, so it is likely to meet or approach aspiration levels and be retained.
Print layout software complements the firm's marking systems and strengthens one-stop solutions, so with available organizational slack we would continue it unless usage proves persistently weak.
